verdict: Lead costs are rising and volume dipped — both are being addressed now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 124 leads at an average cost of $16.91 per lead, entirely through Meta. The most recent week showed cost per lead rising roughly 21% while leads declined — efficiency eroded inside a flat budget, and that trend is being corrected through ad creative and targeting adjustments this week. At the same time, your Google Business Profile went quiet for three days (Nov 11–13), pulling organic actions and search clicks down sharply; that disruption is being investigated and isolated from the paid campaign. Next period you should see cost per lead stabilize and organic visibility recover as both issues are addressed.
